title: Keep It Alive
source: Tamagotchi 30th-anniversary revival: real-time care, care mistakes, permadeath
loop: Pet beeps for a need (hungry/dirty/bored/sick) on a real-time clock; answer with a 10s minigame; each missed call is a care mistake; log in daily or a 24h grace timer runs down
twist: Pets can permanently die of neglect and go to a gravestone garden on your plot; the flex is the oldest LIVING pet on the server leaderboard, not the rarest one; care-mistake count decides the adult form
pet_role: The pet is the alarm clock and the score: its beeps drive every session, its evolution is the readout of how well you cared
money: Revive Charm (49R) fires on the death screen; Pet Sitter 24h (25R) fires at logout when grace is low; Growth Skip (35R) fires at each evolution wait
evidence: Tamagotchi passed 100M units sold by Jul 2025 and sales doubled 2022-2023 (MarketScreener 2025; CNN Jan 8 2026); Uniqlo 30-year collab Dec 2025
roblox_occupancy: No Roblox pet game with real permadeath found (search Sep 30 2026); Adopt Me pets never die; Raise the Server Baby (MSH-086) is Tamagotchi-style but server-wide, not personal permadeath

title: Track Your Runaway Pet
source: GPS pet collars / Tractive-style trackers (pet wearables = 45% of pet-tech 2025)
loop: Every few minutes a random pet in the server bolts; its owner gets GPS pings that lag 5s and drift; anyone can catch a loose pet; the catcher gets a bounty or hands it back for a reward
twist: Location info is delayed and jittery so you predict where it will be; strangers can catch your pet and hold it for ransom, so the owner races the server to their own dog
pet_role: Pets have a breed 'bolt' profile (husky runs far, bulldog sits under a car) that you learn; your pet's escapes are the chase content
money: Live Ping (25R) fires the moment your pet escapes; Recall Whistle (35R) fires when a stranger is closer than you; Bigger Fence (49R) fires after the third escape of a session
evidence: Pet wearables held 45.3% of pet-tech share in 2025; pet-tech market USD 19.1B in 2026 (Grand View Research 2026; GMInsights 2026)
roblox_occupancy: No GPS lost-pet Roblox game found; 'Lost Pet' is only a side event in Cabin Crew Simulator and Cats vs Water (search Sep 30 2026)

title: Catch Your Pet on Cam
source: Pet cameras with treat-toss (Furbo/Petcube) and the 'what my dog does when I leave' clip genre
loop: Place cameras around your house, log off; at next login a 20s replay shows what your pet did overnight (chewed shoes, opened fridge, friend's pet broke in); clean up, buy defences, move cameras
twist: Your pet has a simulated offline life you only ever see through camera replays, and friends' pets can visit your house while you are gone, so the replay is a whodunnit
pet_role: Pets act unsupervised: mischief stats, hidden habits, and cross-house visits make the replays; treats tossed through the cam change tomorrow's behaviour
money: Extra Camera (25R) fires when a blind spot is revealed; Treat-Toss Cam (35R) fires on the replay screen; Night Vision (25R) fires on a dark clip

twist: Asymmetric rules-vs-exploits: owners program feeder logic (RFID, weight, schedule) with blocks, pets exploit loopholes live; every patch creates a new trick
pet_role: Pets are the players: each species has an exploit kit (cat squeezes, dog bulk, rabbit digs); owner pets are the goal state
money: Extra Kibble Refill (25R) fires when the feeder is emptied by raiders; Chip Collar (35R) fires when owners see a collar swap in the log; Decoy Pet (25R) fires on a failed heist
evidence: Smart feeders projected fastest pet-tech CAGR 12.8% 2026-2033 (Grand View Research 2026)

twist: The boundary is drawn live and invisible; dogs only get audio cues, so escaping is echolocation-style; owner must patch holes while dogs stress-test them
